title: Export and share
subtitle: Chapter 7 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: As you work through a match you can star the rallies worth keeping, and those become your highlights.
You can also tag a point with whatever you would call it yourself, like a backhand loop or a serve that keeps letting you down.
Once the match is scored, everything you have marked turns into something you can take away.
Turning on Include score burns the scoreboard into the video, so the file reads the way the match did.
You can render the whole match, only your starred rallies, or every point carrying one tag, in order.
And a share link lets anyone watch it without making an account.
